subtitle: A private offline workspace for your notes.
releaseNotes: v0.4.0: HTML preview now runs full pages — JavaScript-powered sites (scroll reveals, dynamic content, menus) render completely instead of appearing blank, while staying isolated from the app in a sandboxed preview. Preview reloads are debounced while you type and scroll position is preserved across edits. New: VS Code-style code writing assist — autocomplete for HTML tags, attributes, CSS and JavaScript while editing HTML notes.
